jobs.occupation: Senior Recruiter with German (m/f/d) (Recruiter/in)
jobs.description:
Why AMS?

We strive to do things better for the world’s most demanding brands. Is it challenging? Yes. But it’s a challenge that brings us together, where support, collaboration and inclusiveness empower you with a feeling of belonging.

Bring your goals and ambitions. We give you the trust, independence, and flexibility to run your career your way. Our support will bring you opportunity.

Our evolution is happening now, let’s bring it - together.

The Role:

We are currently looking for a Senior Recruiter with German (m/f/d) to support one of our client's – a market leader in investment banking – NatWest Group.

As a Senior Recruiter (m/f/d) you will support with the full end to end lifecycle (for all roles from Analyst to VP Level) via the direct delivery model ensuring Client, key hiring Managers stakeholders and candidates are supported throughout their lifecycle. You will also be supporting creating a talent strategy for your region and driving the achievement of all contractually agreed quality thresholds, SLAs and client satisfaction targets.

You’ll be reporting into a Senior Manager and be working alongside you colleagues across multiple regions as well as being a part of the wider NatWest UK AMS team. You will also have reporting lines into the NatWest HR Team in region.

Key Accountabilities:

- Taking full ownership to ensure the 360-recruitment service is delivered in line with contractual obligations and client service level agreements
- Leading vacancy consultation discussions to agree the recruitment plans with hiring managers– this includes role requirements, sourcing strategy, DEI requirements, pay range, agreed timeframes, responsibilities of all involved, and the selection process.
- Drive down the use of existing reliance on Agency a and educate the HM population on the benefits of direct delivery.
- Leveraging your existing experience, knowledge, and resources whilst also working with experts in sourcing and talent intelligence to develop effective sourcing strategies that enable you to deliver great candidates and lead and influence conversations with your hiring managers.
- Providing subject matter expertise, thought leadership and talent intelligence in recruitment discussions and vacancy briefing calls with Hiring Managers, leaving the discussion with a detailed understanding of the client’s business, the requirements and unique selling points of the role.
- Creating and maintaining trusted partner relationships with Senior hiring managers/stakeholders. Independent execution of the end-to-end delivery of recruitment services to them, providing counsel, advising through insight and SME knowledge on the recruitment process and ensuring that timelines are correctly identified and met
- Championing your candidates. Having honest, quality career discussions that assess candidate suitability for each role and bring your client’s brand to life so that candidates feel excited at the prospect of joining them

Critical Skills & Experience:

- Fluency in English and German, both written & spoken
- Experience in leading end-to-end 360 recruitment processes.
- Experience of sourcing and creating talent pools for future hiring.
- Strong customer focus and the ability to manage Client stakeholders including senior position
- Excellent communication skills and ability to build long-lasting relationships with candidates, clients, and teammates.
- Experience of hiring within Financial Services with preferably Investment Banking.

We strive to do things better for the world’s most demanding brands. Is it challenging? Yes. But it’s a challenge that brings us together, where support, collaboration and inclusiveness empower you with a feeling of belonging.

Bring your goals and ambitions. We give you the trust, independence, and flexibility to run your career your way. Our support will bring you opportunity.
Our evolution is happening now, let’s bring it—together!

In this hybrid position, you will combine two complementary roles: As IT Business Partner, you will be the trusted advisor and primary IT contact for our business units in the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Poland. As IT Project Manager, you will lead and deliver international IT projects across the Group.

Your Role

- Act as the single point of contact between IT and business stakeholders in the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Poland for all new demands, projects and digital initiatives.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels, understand their requirements and translate business needs into scalable, value-adding IT solutions
- Identify opportunities for digitalisation and guide new demands from initial concept through prioritisation and approval to successful implementation
- Coordinate internal teams, external service providers and vendors to deliver IT projects on time, within scope and within budget
- Define project objectives, scope, resources and schedules in close collaboration with all relevant business and IT stakeholders
- Develop and maintain project plans and documentation, monitor progress and performance, and provide transparent status reporting
- Manage project risks, dependencies and changes to scope, schedule and costs, escalating issues where necessary
- Align IT services and investments with business priorities while continuously improving service quality and measurable business value
- Keep stakeholders informed about project delivery, service performance, innovations and emerging technologies
- Contribute ideas on digital trends and responsible AI use that improve processes and the way we work
- Maintain regular on-site contact with our locations in the region and support international projects beyond your assigned Business Partner scope
- Facilitate demand management, prioritisation and alignment of business requirements within the Group IT portfolio.
- Ensure that technology initiatives and IT investments deliver measurable business value and support strategic objectives.

Your Profile

- A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or a comparable qualification
- Three to five years of professional experience in a comparable position, ideally as an IT Business Partner, IT Project Manager or Business Analyst
- Proven experience in successfully managing IT projects and sound knowledge of both project life cycle and systems development life cycle methodologies
- A strong understanding of core business processes, particularly in areas such as Finance, HR, Operations and Sales
- Broad knowledge of current technologies and digitalisation trends, with the ability to identify their potential business value

- Excellent analytical, organisational and stakeholder-management skills, combined with a structured and solution-oriented approach
- Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with stakeholders from the shop floor to C-suite level
- Business-fluent Czech and English language skills, both written and spoken; German language skills are an advantage
- A client-focused, proactive and self-driven mindset with the ability to build trust and long-term relationships
- Willingness to travel regularly within the region and, where required, internationally

Your benefits

jobs.occupation: Head of European Accounting (Hub) (m/f/d) - Bexbach | Full-time (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:
You want more than just preparing financial statements – you want to rebuild an entire European accounting organization? Then take on functional and operational leadership across our German, Swiss, and Norwegian operations.

Why join us?

- International responsibility across multiple countries and accounting standards (HGB/OR, IFRS)
- ️ A genuine opportunity to shape the future: drive the realignment and modernization of the European accounting function
- System ownership: lead the Dynamics 365 Business Central upgrade and the digitalization of R2R/P2P/O2C
- Team and leadership responsibility: build, recruit, and coach a high-performing accounting team

About us – in brief

Headquartered in Bexbach, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5% – built on a sole focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research and technology development.

Tasks

- Prepare standalone financial statements for the European entities under HGB/OR and IFRS, including notes/disclosures and management reports, as well as IFRS interim financial statements
- Take overall responsibility for the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement of the European entities
- Ensure accurate, timely monthly, quarterly, and annual closings, including general ledger, sub-ledgers, provisions, and accruals
- Ensure the quality of all balance sheet positions through regular balance sheet analyses, account reconciliations, and cash flow reporting
- Hold functional and operational responsibility for the German and Swiss entities, and manage external accounting service providers for Norwegian operations
- Oversee the accounting treatment of assets and activities related to the UK business classified as "Held for Sale"
- Act as the key contact for auditors, tax advisors, and external audit bodies
- Further develop an effective internal control system
- Serve as the central point of contact for complex accounting and financial reporting matters under HGB and IFRS (including IFRS 16, IFRS 5, impairment testing, purchase price allocations, intercompany reconciliations, foreign currency valuation)
- Own the annual budgeting and planning process, including forecasts and variance analyses
- Act as a business partner to operational units on financial matters and investment decisions
- Lead the realignment and modernization of the European accounting function
- Lead the Dynamics 365 Business Central upgrade and the standardization/digitalization of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash
- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing accounting team (recruiting, coaching, development)

Requirements

Must-have

- Completed degree in business administration, finance, accounting, or a comparable field
- Several years of leadership experience in accounting within an international company
- Proven experience managing multiple entities and countries
- Strong hands-on operational accounting experience
- Excellent knowledge of accounting under HGB and IFRS
- Fluent in English; German language skills are mandatory

Nice-to-have

- Qualification as a certified public accountant (Wirtschaftsprüfer), tax advisor (Steuerberater), or comparable
- Proven track record in transformation projects, organizational development, and ERP implementations
- Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or comparable ERP systems
- Strong communication, leadership, and change management skills

Benefits

- A varied, strategically significant position with a high degree of personal and leadership responsibility
- Individual career and development opportunities within an internationally active company
- Attractive compensation with additional benefits such as Christmas and holiday bonuses, plus performance bonuses
- Company pension scheme
- Free water and coffee
- Employee discounts on company products
- Company events (summer party, Christmas party, company run)

What happens next

Bexbach |  immediate start | ⏳ Full-time

Send us your application – no need for a perfectly polished cover letter. We'll get back to you promptly.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Manager (f/md) for Supplier Relationship Management & Supply Chain Resilience, you will work closely with the management team of GS D Procurement and the Gas Services Project Orion. Your role is essential to drive objectives of the ORION project to de-risk the GS D supply chain. In this role you report to the Head of Commodity Management and will work closely with the head of GS D procurement and the CPOs of the product lines, as well as the project organization in Gas Services. The tasks range from monitoring, improvement and developing the supplier relationship management and risk-mitigation in the supply chain. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Establish, maintain, and actively manage supplier relationship management activities
* Analyze supply chain de-risking activities across GS D, benchmark and exchange with Orion project team members on Gas Services level, drive improvements and process harmonization
* Drive cost-saving initiatives and risk-mitigation actions together with commodity managers, project management, finance, engineering, and supply chain teams
* Increase data-driven decision making, leveraging integrated supply chain tools and support of AI
* Prepare transparent project progress tracking, identifying risks and taking mitigation action with SQ, Procurement, Engineering in GS D

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, combined with project management skills, and understanding of supply chain topics across the value chain from Sales, to Engineering and to Procurement. 
* Longstanding professional experience in managing complex projects, financial analysis, procurement, or a comparable environment, typically gained over 5+ years.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, strategic-thinking, influencing, and process-improvement skills across procurement, finance, project management, and supply chain interfaces.
* Proven ability to manage complex projects with cross-functional stakeholders and track record of realizing project targets on time & on budget.
* Fluent in English and German is an advantage 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
